limitations: First-failure runs roll back model state. A committed-token count of zero does not mean no computation occurred; requested-token and position coverage fields distinguish them.
Only the chat prompt completes all 40 layers through prefill and 32 teacher-forced tokens in each mode. Other cases stop at their first failure. Later positions remain untested.
Even the complete chat runs lack observations for some oracle internals. Missing coverage cannot pass G1.
Identical-input component agreement does not qualify connected state, free greedy generation, CUDA execution, Pylon serving, or recovery.
The complete-chat process was intentionally stopped after both mode reports were saved; its exit status 143 is retained in the evidence, along with the stop reason.
Run timings include observer/report overhead and concurrent diagnostic processes; they are not W3 performance qualification.
Per-layer hashes locate the earliest unequal residual; numerical bounds determine the first numerical failure. They are separate checks.
CPU TP8 mode reproduces demonstrated dtype/reduction boundaries; it does not claim exact emulation of every CUDA primitive or collective.
